title: 卓上オシロスコープ
description: 電子工作室・学校の実習机に置く無銘の卓上測定器。無表示の画面、固定ノブとソフトキー、四つの実開口付き入力ソケット、上げた取手と側面支点、脚、背面の冷却グリル・電源入口外形を造形。波形、数値、プローブ、外部装置は含みません。静的な外観モデルで、信号取得・表示・電気測定や校正性能はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.400 × 0.284 × 0.263 m、8,512三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An unbranded benchtop instrument for electronics rooms and teaching desks. It includes a blank screen, fixed knobs/soft keys, four input sockets with real openings, raised handle and side pivots, feet, rear cooling grille and power-entry exterior. Waveforms, readings, probes and external equipment are absent. This static appearance model has no signal capture, display behavior, electrical measurement or calibrated performance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.400 × 0.284 × 0.263 m; 8,512 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
